title: Observe EUR opening sparse coordinates in ordinary execution
changes: Confirm the E158 sparse-coordinate reader in a neutral ordinary EUR opening continuation.
validation: Wine e158-sparse-ordinary-wine-htdztv4y observes all 19 sparse halfwords with 38 typed requests and zero raw requests while source bytes are poisoned; the first reader frame matches the original complete state and clock.
limitations: Only one neutral interpreter continuation and one matching frame are covered; other scenes, native dispatch, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurement.
